RESULT

Keep the same leading F=F_* and the same full twelve-dimensional cubic
space as in PROOF.txt. Let p be ANY globally ROC polynomial with leading
cF, c>0. Consider the actual periodic potential

 psi(x,y)=e1 sin x+e2 sin y
       +(e1+e2) sin(x+y-delta1)
       +(1/2,1/4) sin(2x+y-delta1-delta2).                  (1)

For ALL real delta1,delta2, means M, overall amplitudes rho and common
proper output rotations, one has

        <p(M+rho Dpsi)>-p(M)>=(c/200)<|rho Dpsi|^4>.        (2)

Thus a pattern with TWO OVERLAPPING cubic resonances is controlled,
including the fourth-order interference between them. The four relative
amplitudes in (1) are fixed. They are not claimed arbitrary. Domain
translations account for the other two individual wave phases.

Moreover, any finite collection of blocks from (1) and the arbitrary-
amplitude triad class of PROOF.txt can be combined at frequency scales
9^j, with independent phases, output rotations and overall amplitudes.
The SAME constant c/200 holds for the total gradient, independently
of the finite number of blocks.

This is still a restricted variational theorem. Arbitrary resonance
networks, unrestricted relative amplitudes of the overlapping block,
and global QC of the original full polynomial face remain open.

RESONANT GLUING BY POSITIVE RANK-ONE HESSIAN QUADRATURE
30 October 2026. Principal construction and exact internal certificate.

MAIN THEOREM

Keep the explicit rational, non-aligned quartic F=F_* in the retained
Hopf certificate. Let p be ANY globally rank-one-convex polynomial of
degree <=4 with leading part cF, c>0. Its cubic may be ANY of the twelve
admissible modes, not just the four translations. Its quadratic is its
ACTUAL ROC quadratic, not a replacement by a large isotropic addition.

Let

 phi(x,y)=a e1 sin(x+theta1)+b e2 sin(y+theta2)
                           +d(e1+e2) sin(x+y+theta3).        (1)

For ALL real amplitudes a,b,d, ALL phases, ALL means M, and every common
proper output rotation of this field, one has the uniform strict bound

       <p(M+Dphi)>-p(M) >= (c/200)<|Dphi|^4>.               (2)

There is also an unbounded-mode extension. Take ANY finite sum of blocks
(1), with independent amplitudes, phases and proper output rotations,
at frequency scales 5^j. Divide the potential amplitude of each block
by its frequency scale, so its gradient amplitude is as in (1). Then
the SAME bound (2) holds for the total gradient, with constant c/200
independent of the number of blocks.

The sibling OVERLAP_PROOF.txt additionally controls a four-wave block
with two overlapping cubic resonances, all its relative phases, and
their coupled fourth-order interference. Its relative amplitudes are
fixed; arbitrary relative amplitudes of that block remain unclassified.

This controls genuine cubic resonances. Eight explicit fields INSIDE
this class detect all eight nontranslation correlation modes of the
original polynomial face. Thus the result does not evade those modes
by imposing their vanishing.

The unrestricted QC of the 28-dimensional face is still OPEN. Arbitrary
overlapping resonance networks and arbitrary spatial/output geometries
are not covered. These test classes are not asserted dense in all
compatible fields. No Morrey counterexample, global Morrey theorem,
historical priority or external independent audit is claimed.
